purpose: Illustrative requirement examples, not current protocol parameters, investment advice or executable inputs.

token_launch.transition_rule: Confirm authoritative venue/program migration state; do not infer from a market-cap level.

candidate_triggers.metric: declared circulating market cap in USD
declared circulating market cap in USD
candidate_triggers.meaning: Y can change position or campaign policy, not create an executable exit

candidate_triggers.threshold_status: illustrative user example, not selected policy
candidate_triggers.boundary: example at or below threshold; strict boundary must be confirmed
candidate_triggers.reference: price at t versus admissible observation at t-300s
candidate_triggers.data_requirement: sufficiently fine timestamped price path; fifteen-minute bars insufficient

candidate_triggers.threshold_status: illustrative user example, not selected policy
candidate_triggers.reference: price at t versus admissible observation at t-3600s

token_launch.coupled_failure_example: Migration delays observation; depth falls; both drop triggers become observable together. Prioritize once; do not spend the same reserve twice. Exit may partially fill or fail.

dex.mechanism_variant_required: constant-product, concentrated-liquidity, orderbook or other; do not blend mechanics

candidate_branches.condition: rapid removal of usable pool depth
candidate_branches.measurement: reserve/depth at specified trade size; concentrated liquidity needs active ranges
responses: revise treasury incentive plan if controllable
candidate_branches.effects: quotes worsen, routes shift, LP fees/inventory change

candidate_branches.condition: scheduled reward expiry followed by possible LP exit
candidate_branches.measurement: reward schedule, positions and exit observations
candidate_branches.effects: treasury cost, adverse selection and fee revenue

candidate_branches.condition: volume or executed quotes lose competitiveness
candidate_branches.measurement: routing/quotes plus scoped executed volume, not TVL alone
responses: compare only fee/control changes actually permitted
candidate_branches.effects: LP revenue, treasury runway and trader cost

candidate_branches.condition: stale dependent data or chain congestion
candidate_branches.measurement: only relevant feeds, confirmations, errors and quote freshness
candidate_branches.effects: unknown conditions, delayed or failed transactions; recovery criteria required

dex.stress_combination: Rewards expire, LPs withdraw and volatile external price generates adverse-selection flow before operators can respond.
